notes.title: Devlog #4 – What’s New in Corner Shop: Nightshift
notes.content:
Watch the video![previewyoutube="oH3WBJbh3DI;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve got a lot of exciting updates we’ve been working on recently:

🎰 Casino – the much-anticipated feature is finally here!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6f1f5c749ddc40f30b330e66b57dabf6caa036a2.gif"]



💊 Medicine & Coffee – now you can restore your mental health with medicine, and when the night shift starts to drain your energy, a hot cup of coffee will keep you going.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/d1192b383c067030885406a95bce91e058cff383.gif"]



🧽 Store Cleanliness – we’ve reworked the dirt & stain system. The cleaner your shop, the better tips you’ll receive from customers.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/e948e920f9820bda65d1388cbcfce4befe92303c.jpg"]

 🛍️ Bagging System – based on your feedback, we’ve added an extra step: now you’ll need to hand customers a shopping bag at the checkout.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/6a7ac5310ff7498daf834ad6d97077a6c2f9b799.jpg"]

 📦 Parcels – customers can now come in with pick-up slips. It’s your job to hand out the correct package and verify the tracking number.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/c43c0b71510154d5a3bc83d442d1bfdea52714e7.jpg"]

And this is just part of what’s coming – we’re continuing to make the night shift more immersive (and unpredictable 😉).

Let us know in the comments what you think of these new systems and which one you’re most excited about!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/29032e3fa78e4dbbef3556e94c52666fb3c65e8b.gif"]

notes.title: Demo Update & Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
First of all — huge thanks to everyone who played the Corner Shop: NightShift demo and sent in feedback. We’ve been reading it all, and many of the changes in this patch come directly from your suggestions. 
[previewyoutube="eRZc2R9Z18I;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]📦 UPDATE – Version 0.7.15.47🧩 Gameplay & Mechanics
Refactored quest system and whiteboard — quests now switch language instantly without delay.

New mechanic: some NPCs may arrive with invalid ID photos — the player can detect and react accordingly.

Improved NPC age randomization to better match their appearance.

Adjusted player movement speed in specific areas for balance.

Improved interaction logic and fixed hidden dirt cleaning issues.

Fixed trash objects not colliding with the mop.

Added visual indicators for blocked phone apps.

Dialogue system improvements — new dialogue options added.

Refined horror sequences and scripted events for better clarity and timing.
🎮 UI & UX
Pause menu improvements, including resolution scale setting at game start.

Mouse sensitivity setting added for improved comfort.

Better widget focus handling and keyboard navigation.

Changed calendar format for clarity.

Improved notepad and navigation widgets.

Bank app UI rework.

Added visual indicators for blocked apps in the phone UI.

Fixed localization issues and added missing translations.

Updated phone and flashlight textures.

Fixed language change behavior in quests and menus.
🔊 Audio
Improved audio attenuation for products and store speakers.

Added concurrency limit for UI sounds to avoid clutter.

Fixed voice-over timing in horror sequences.

Reduced loading screen music volume.
🎨 Visuals & Performance
Optimized textures for better performance (resolution adjustments where appropriate).

Adjusted field of view during certain sequences for better immersion.

Fixed lighting and shadow casting in multiple areas.
[hr][/hr]📓 DEVLOG #3 – What’s Next?
We’ve seen your feedback about the horror layer of the game — and we agree: it can go further.
We’re working on new ways to unsettle you, blending psychological tension with physical threats.

Here’s an early look at something in development:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/0230319967ce6e3e4510855eaa623309a89f2651.gif"]



This entity moves through ceiling vents, its tangled, cable-like form weaving in and out of shadows.
Is it just a schizophrenic hallucination of our protagonist’s fractured mind?
Or is it a real creature, hunting you from above?
We’re not saying — you’ll have to discover that yourself.

This is not in the current demo — it’s part of ongoing development inspired by your feedback. Expect more creatures, more psychological twists, and more moments where you won’t be sure what’s real.
[hr][/hr]
💬 Let us know what you think of the update in the comments.
📌 Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get notified about future updates and the full release!

notes.title: We’d Love Your Feedback – Tell Us About Your Night Shift
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Thank you so much to everyone who played the Corner Shop: NightShift demo during the PlayWay Publisher Sale! We've been blown away by your interest, streams, and first impressions.

Now that many of you have had a chance to spend a night behind the counter… we’d love to hear how it went.



What kind of feedback helps us most?

Whether you:

Noticed a bug or technical issue

Had a cool gameplay suggestion

Got creeped out by something and want to share the moment

Or simply want to tell us what you liked (or didn’t)



Where to share your thoughts

You can leave your feedback in:




The Steam Community Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3306990/discussions/

Our Discord server Discord: https://discord.gg/nAwUAmSB





Your input is helping us polish the game and prioritize future features.



And yes — we’re already working on new content based on what players are asking for.



If you haven’t played the demo yet — it’s still available:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853600/Corner_Shop_Nightshift_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you again for being part of this early phase. Your shift’s not over yet.




— The Live Motion Games Team

notes.title: Corner Shop: NightShift – Demo available July 24!
notes.content:
Corner Shop: NightShift – Demo Coming July 24th! 🌙
Get ready for your first night shift.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/f2deac14525e3a2a3b3ca18cdf6048c87fd71d5c.gif"]


We’re excited to announce that the demo for Corner Shop: NightShift will launch on July 24th! This is your chance to dive into a psychological horror experience that blurs the line between reality and nightmare.

🔦 Step into the shoes of Adam Callahan, a man trying to rebuild his life after personal tragedy by taking a night job at a small convenience store.

🕯️ The demo offers about 1 hour of gameplay, covering the first 3 in-game days. It’s a taste of what’s to come – introducing the game’s mechanics, atmosphere, and the story’s unsettling undertones...
What to expect:
A dark and eerie late-night atmosphere

Flashbacks from Adam’s past, including his trip to Japan

A blend of store management and psychological horror mechanics

Early choices that shape relationships and future story paths

 We’d love to hear your thoughts – your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the game.



📅 Mark your calendar: July 24, 2025 – The demo will be free to play on Steam!



Add the game to your wishlist and prepare for your first shift...

notes.title: Corner Shop: NightShift – demo coming late July
notes.content:
Corner Shop: NightShift – demo coming late July
We're excited to announce that the Corner Shop: NightShift demo will launch on Steam in late July. This early build introduces key elements from the upcoming Early Access version, offering a playable first look into the game's tone, systems, and story.


[hr][/hr]Screenshots from the demo:
SCREENSHOT 1 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/42916bada22f8db4cd3392837a64ebe8fc2e4fbf.png"]

\[SCREENSHOT 2] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/02a2f7a27669ff98db84c7e536ad238f3a9afc13.png"]

\[SCREENSHOT 3]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574858/62bc3f9799148ea50b94eaef93f3abc0c39d010e.png"]
[hr][/hr]What's in the demo?
Introduction to Adam Callahan's story – a man trying to rebuild his life after a personal collapse.

A slow-burn, immersive psychological horror atmosphere, set during night shifts in a lonely corner store.

Early versions of the store mechanics, interaction systems, and the in-game phone and SMS features.

A focus on narrative tension, subtle unease, and gradually unlocking layers of gameplay.

The demo will be permanently available and regularly updated based on player feedback.
[hr][/hr]Frequent devlogs incoming
Leading up to the demo release, we’ll be publishing regular devlogs where we’ll dive deeper into the game's mechanics, inspirations, design choices, and behind-the-scenes development.
If you're curious how we mix mundane routines with psychological dread – stay tuned.
[hr][/hr]Localization
The demo will be available in 16 languages, with full English voice-over.
If wishlist numbers grow, we plan to expand voice-over support to more languages.
[hr][/hr]Media release
Alongside the demo, we’ll be releasing:

A brand new official trailer

Fresh in-game screenshots

Updated gameplay footage
[hr][/hr]Share your feedback
Join our Discord to chat with the team and other players. Your feedback directly impacts development:



https://discord.gg/qFtTy6Uh



You can also share your thoughts on the Steam Community forum – we read everything.
[hr][/hr]Add to your wishlist
Wishlists help small dev teams more than you might think.
